_comment: What is already in each piece of labware when the run starts, so the run map can show which wells are filled and the liquid pages can tell when a stock runs dry. Keys are a tracked plate's starting location (same keys as plates.json) or '<node>:<deck slot>' for a reservoir that never moves. Wells take a name (A6), a rectangular range (A1:H8) or a comma-separated list. volume_ul is a PROPOSED loading volume: what this single run draws, plus dead volume, not a measurement. This version's reagent columns differ from the 3-round one: Golden Gate mix sits in column 7 and PCR mix in column 10, both read from the protocols' master_mix_start_well.
